content.short: Taiko is a fully Ethereum-equivalent ZK-Rollup scaling solution that inherits L1 security and liveness for builders.
content.description: Taiko is a leading developer-ready Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, powered by Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine technology. As a Type 1 ZK-Rollup, Taiko achieves full bytecode-level equivalence with Ethereum, allowing developers to deploy existing dApps and tools with zero modifications. The network features a unique "Based Rollup" architecture, where Ethereum Layer 1 validators handle the sequencing of Taiko blocks, ensuring the network inherits robust liveness. By utilizing ZK-proofs, Taiko provides high throughput and lower costs while maintaining cryptographic integrity.
content.meta: Taiko is a Type 1 zkEVM Layer 2 network providing full Ethereum equivalence and decentralized scaling. Discover Taiko and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
